title: 久
teacherNotes: Release integrated L267 on latest origin/main; dependencies resolved: L265, L266.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Release verified against production JSON through L267.
usageNotes: Use 睡著, not 睡着.
All display text must use learned chars only. Image prompts may describe the scene but the image itself must not contain text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, or watermarks.
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for every image.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family continuity from L154/L162/L163 for protagonist mother, father, and little girl.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, or readable marks.
Sickness and tiredness scenes must be gentle and safe, with no severe illness, death, injury, emergency, horror, or panic.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 久 as public/assets/lessons/L267/audio/char-u4e45.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在家裡或安全遊戲區玩太久，坐下來休息一下。畫面要清楚表現玩了一段時間後休息；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
主角小女孩剛剛看書太久，坐在書桌旁或床邊揉眼睛、打呵欠，很想睡。書頁不可出現可讀文字、數字或注音。
主角小女孩生病後在家休養，主角媽媽在旁邊照顧，氣氛溫和，不要做成嚴重醫療場景。不可有文字、數字、藥品標籤或注音。

approvedSentences.text: 裝了很久，才把沙發裝好。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 裝了很久才把沙發裝好
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角爸爸在家裡組裝沙發，主角小女孩在旁邊幫忙或觀看，沙發剛裝好，旁邊可有沒有文字的工具零件。不可有說明書文字、數字、標籤或注音。

approvedSentences.text: 多休息，才能早點把病養好。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 多休息才能早點把病養好
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角媽媽溫和提醒生病中的主角小女孩多休息，才能早點養好病。畫面可在臥室或客廳，主角小女孩躺著或坐著休息；不可有文字、數字、藥品標籤或注音。

stage4Plan.reason: 「看書太久」是本課核心用法，目標字清楚。

releaseSideRepairs: Cleared stale old package status after L265-L266 were resolved in release order.
